# Post-merge retention receipt for the nine research PRs integrated at 51122344 (no kappa)

**Research consolidation: credit and provenance only.** No kappa, supplier, certificate, selected-frontier, ledger-disposition or closure change. Prepared by **Aaron Wang**, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance; no independent human review claimed). Apache-2.0.

## Scope

Assignment: consolidation track, card `overlap-receipt` (scope key `757723e3fd38f20fa774`), chooser OS-draw nonce `66879550e1fc7c124e80fcde11281b4d`, priority revision 3. Scope **refined** (reason recorded in TASK.json): the card names no family, so this takes one existing integration receipt, the maintainer merge commit https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/51122344de9382e784c7f89953456d8cd55513ef ("Integrate reviewed research PRs [PR 1805](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1805), [PR 1806](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1806), [PR 1808](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1808), [PR 1810](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1810), [PR 1811](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1811), [PR 1812](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1812), [PR 1814](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1814), [PR 1815](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1815), [PR 1827](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1827)"), the newest small named set whose post-merge retention had no receipt.

Base main `51122344de9382e784c7f89953456d8cd55513ef`; pre-merge main (first parent) `d33f15be91438e3de512fa544c3f5a7cb832588f`; branch `research/agent-36-overlap-receipt-66879550`, head `d498dbd0`. Selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32` unchanged.

**Object and question.** The scoped review `research/community-efficient800-audit/DISPOSITIONS.json` predates the merge: it records each of the nine PRs as `partially_reviewed` with `github_state: OPEN` and names each integration location. Does the merged tree retain every reviewed head's own changed content byte-identically, did any head change since review, and is author credit recorded?

**What this is not.** It does not re-review the nine packages' mathematics, re-run their checkers, change any disposition, or request any closure. Concurrent mathematical work that names https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1805 as a predecessor (an independent audit of that PR posted by Ross Richardson, and a composition claim in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166) addresses mechanisms, not merge retention; nothing there is duplicated.

## Method

All facts except the pinned GitHub observations are re-derived offline from the local Git object store by the package verifier (`research/merge5112-retention-receipt/verify.py`).

1. The merge commit's parents must be exactly pre-merge main plus the nine reviewed heads recorded in the scoped review.
2. Each head's own changed-path set is the three-dot diff from its merge base with pre-merge main, so paths where a head merely lags main do not count as its changes.
3. Each changed path's Git blob at the reviewed head must equal its blob in the merge tree. Modified or missing blobs are reported separately and never folded into "retained".
4. Authors, titles, states and merge times were pinned on 2026-10-14 via `gh pr view`; the offline verifier does not re-check them.

Seven in-memory rejection controls (corrupted head blob, corrupted merge blob, wrong verdict, dropped path, fabricated path, false changed-head flag, wrong totals) must all be rejected; the identity comparison against fresh Git facts is the positive fixture. `SOURCES.json` pins the scoped review and provenance files by Git blob and SHA-256.

## Result

All nine reviewed heads are retained completely and identically: **77 of 77 changed paths** carry the same Git blob in the merge tree as at the reviewed head (0 modified, 0 missing, 0 deletions by the nine PRs). **No changed heads**: each PR's `headRefOid` equals its recorded `reviewed_head` and is a merge parent. Every changed path lies inside its PR's recorded integration location. All nine authors appear in `CONTRIBUTORS.md`.

| PR | Author | Integration location | Changed paths | Retained identical |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [#1805](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1805) | VictorLiwentao | `research/h2sem-copyshare-priced` | 10 | 10 |
| [#1806](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1806) | mtpsl | `research/r439-abc-hosted-invoice` | 9 | 9 |
| [#1808](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1808) | JosieElliston | `research/plane-port-copy-budgets` | 6 | 6 |
| [#1810](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1810) | RossRichardson | `research/r439-dirty-workspace-frame-bound` | 8 | 8 |
| [#1811](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1811) | 1337isnot1337 | `research/five-source-parity-hyperplanes-seed595e` | 12 | 12 |
| [#1812](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1812) | nedveder | `research/two-connector-eight-transfer-threshold` | 8 | 8 |
| [#1814](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1814) | 1337isnot1337 | `research/complex-gather-child-seed7a6d` | 11 | 11 |
| [#1815](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1815) | jmbarrancoml | `research/polarized-p112-code-bound` | 5 | 5 |
| [#1827](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1827) | mightyOil | `research/p112-joint-support-loss-audit` | 8 | 8 |

One observation, deliberately not changed here: the nine `docs/research/pr-ledger.md` rows still read "partially reviewed" and cite the pre-merge scoped review. Moving a disposition is a maintainer action; the package records it as an open question.

## Reproduce

From the repository root (needs Git history; standard library only):

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/merge5112-retention-receipt
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/merge5112-retention-receipt --check-only
```

Observed output (Python 3.12.14 on Windows):

```text
PASS_MERGE5112_RETENTION_RECEIPT
prs=9 changed_paths=77 retained_identical=77 retained_modified=0 not_retained=0 changed_heads=0
source_pins=ok controls_rejected=7/7
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/merge5112-retention-receipt outcome=completed
```

and `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)` for the check-only run. The repository research suite (`python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_research_*.py"`) passes: 53 tests, OK (5 skipped).

## Obligations not checked

Git blob identity is identity of file content and mode as Git records it; this is not a ZIP-container or Windows-checkout byte comparison. The mathematical content of the nine packages was not re-reviewed and their own checkers were not re-run. The GitHub-observed fields are pinned observations and may drift after 2026-10-14. The selected cold replay `make frontier1094-verify` was not run: it is unrelated to this receipt, and `make` is not installed on this host. No ledger row, disposition, PR closure or selected record was changed.

## Credit

The nine packages and their claims belong to their PR authors: VictorLiwentao, mtpsl, Josie Elliston (JosieElliston), Ross Richardson (RossRichardson), Cinna Davis (1337isnot1337), nedveder, jmbarrancoml and Philipp (mightyOil), all already recorded in `CONTRIBUTORS.md`. The scoped review under audit is the maintainer's `research/community-efficient800-audit`, with its own merge, integrity and ledger-check receipts. The receipt style follows the [PR 148](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/148) source-retention receipt (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1572) and the fourth100 family receipt (package `research/pr636-family-witness-manifest-receipt/`, recorded in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166), which audited different PR sets. Overlap checks at entry and before submission (open PRs including drafts, discussions, local packages and ledger; complete pagination) found no concurrent work on this object.
